newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EBRD mulls investment into Estonian Land Bank.
newsitem.headline: EBRD mulls investment into Estonian Land Bank.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is considering investing in small Estonian bank, Land Bank, an EBRD official said on Friday.
EBRD Estonia representative Andre Kuusvek confirmed a report in newspaper Aripaev that the bank might take part in a capital raising exercise by Land Bank.
"We will make the decision next year," Kuusvek told Reuters.
The bank's net assets in October were 1.01 billion kroons and it made a loss of 25.5 million kroons, central bank figures showed.
The Estonian banking market is dominated by the largest bank in the Baltic states, Hansapank, which also has a subsidiary in Latvia.
